lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently performed poorly across 2 tests and was stopped early due to worsening sign-in rates.

Adding home screen wait-time info (4 wins), adoption redesigns (2 wins), and finish redesigns (2 wins) were helpful across winning tests, though several tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Changes to sign-in copy, sign-in hints, sign-in notifications, choose-path copy, and finish new-flow flows consistently showed no clear effect across 2 or more tests each.
Choose-path layout modifications consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance across 4 tests.
Categories with only a single test (such as adoption incentives, adoption notifications, or finish notifications) still provide thin evidence.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests while overestimating changes that yielded no clear effect or performed worse.

candidates.title: pick_friend_interactive_storyline_flow
candidates.change: Introduce an interactive pet personality storyline selection component inside pick_friend where users select dialogue options to customize companion behavior.
candidates.why: Adoption has high drop-off and high duration (89s median / 1017s mean). Interactive storyline flows help users pick the right pet and increase engagement.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Choose a pet personality and see how they interact with your desktop environment.

guard.reason: Pick a friend screen loses its required job of allowing the user to choose a pet by replacing pet selection with personality selection.

candidates.title: waiting_screen_pet_setup_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen layout to combine live rendering status indicators with an active setup progress list.
candidates.why: Home waiting duration is high (median 201s / mean 2336s). Past wins show waiting screen information and layout updates retain users during initial setup render.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home
waiting.body: Your pet engine is loading graphics, assets, and system permissions.

guard.reason: 'waiting.replace.wait_status[0]': a checklist cannot do the wait_status job (use ['animation', 'mascot', 'preview', 'progress', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel'])

candidates.title: new_screen_desktop_pet_controls_basics
candidates.change: Add a new onboarding screen after home_intro explaining how to summon, move, hide, and interact with the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails (3 for pet controls, 4 for desktop features) reported users struggling to find or control their pet after setup completed.

new_screen_desktop_pet_controls_basics.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_screen_desktop_pet_controls_basics.body: Right-click your pet anytime to hide, customize, or open the control dashboard. Drag to move them around your screen.

guard.reason: screen 'new_screen_desktop_pet_controls_basics' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: home_intro_interactive_onboarding_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a two-column setup welcome hub with immediate desktop placement feedback.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 42.6% and finish step has long mean duration (5815s). Redesigning the final step helps guide users past desktop launch issues.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Your pet is active and running in your system tray.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[1]': a badge cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: sign_in_cloud_backup_incentive
candidates.change: Add a prominent cloud save badge and data protection promise to the sign_in screen.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in or re-installing. Explicit data backup promises address key user hesitation at sign_in.

components.text: Cloud Protection Active: Your pet progress & custom traits are permanently saved

guard.reason: Adds a cloud backup status badge to sign_in without violating pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users and has 8 support emails, but sign-in copy and incentive tweaks historically produce modest gains.

candidates.title: upload_photos_processing_wait_info
candidates.change: Enable live time estimates and stage progress notifications during custom photo upload processing.
candidates.why: Custom photo generation is error-prone (3 support emails) and user drop-off during adoption step is significant.

upload_photos.hint: Processing custom graphics... This usually takes under 30 seconds.

guard.reason: Adds real progress and time estimates to photo upload processing.

candidates.score_note: Wait-time info is a strong historical winner (+2.1% across 7 tests) and addresses photo processing drop-off and 3 support emails.

candidates.title: waiting_desktop_readiness_notification
candidates.change: Add desktop readiness status notification and completion audio alert when rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Home wait time mean is 2336s (over 38 minutes), indicating many users switch windows and forget the app.

guard.reason: Adds readiness notification and completion chime to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets extreme 38-minute average wait time on home, though step drop-off is already low (4.1%) and notification results are mixed.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_command_flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive quick action component to home_intro allowing users to test pet reaction commands before closing setup.
candidates.why: Addresses post-onboarding confusion regarding how to talk to or hide the desktop pet.

guard.reason: Adds interactive quick-action components to home_intro inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish new_flow changes consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance (-1.8% historically) and require release work.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_split_layout
candidates.change: Switch adoption_certificate to a split layout showing the signed certificate on the left and desktop launcher settings on the right.
candidates.why: Adoption step changes have produced high-performing test wins in previous iterations.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion is registered! Review your certificate details below.

guard.reason: Redesigns adoption_certificate layout while preserving the certificate presentation.

candidates.score_note: Layout modifications consistently underperformed or degraded conversion across 4 tests (-1.7% average) and need screen layout reworks.

candidates.title: upload_photos_preview_stage_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign upload_photos into a stage layout featuring live image validation indicators and preview animations.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted custom pet creation failures or poor graphic results.

upload_photos.headline: Custom Pet Creator
upload_photos.body: Upload photos to generate your custom desktop companion.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently degraded performance across 2 tests and was stopped early due to worsening sign-in rates.

Choose-path layout modifications (4 tests) and sign-in notifications (4 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance.
